description: Full Signer CRUD: add soft-delete field to schema, migrate DB, create dedicated /api/signers routes, build /admin/signers UI page, update existing org signers endpoint to exclude soft-deleted records, and update sidebar nav. Depends on FEAT-F01 (build must be green first). Independent of FEAT-F03 and FEAT-F04.
steps: Add `deletedAt DateTime?` field to the Signer model in prisma/schema.prisma, inside the Signer block after the `updatedAt` field. Do not change any other models. Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-signer-soft-delete` then `npx prisma generate`. Confirm src/generated/prisma/ is updated with the new field.

Create src/lib/schemas/signer.ts with two Zod exports: (1) `CreateSignerSchema = z.object({ orgId: z.string().min(1), fullName: z.string().min(1).max(200), title: z.string().min(1).max(200), employeeId: z.string().max(100).optional().nullable(), isActive: z.boolean().default(true) })`. (2) `UpdateSignerSchema = CreateSignerSchema.omit({ orgId: true }).partial()`. Export TypeScript types: `CreateSignerInput`, `UpdateSignerInput`.

Create src/app/api/signers/route.ts. GET handler: authenticate with `requireAdmin()`. Accept query params: `orgId` (required), `search` (optional string), `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, max 100). Query `db.signer.findMany({ where: { orgId, deletedAt: null, ...(search ? { OR: [{ fullName: { contains: search } }, { title: { contains: search } }, { employeeId: { contains: search } }] } : {}) }, orderBy: { fullName: 'asc' }, skip: (page-1)*limit, take: limit, select: { id, fullName, title, employeeId, isActive, createdAt } })`. Also run `db.signer.count({ where })`. Return `apiSuccess({ data, total, page, limit })`. POST handler: authenticate, parse body with `CreateSignerSchema`, create signer, call `writeAuditEvent({ action: 'SIGNER_CREATED', entityType: 'Signer', entityId: signer.id, actorId: session.user.id, meta: { fullName: signer.fullName, orgId: signer.orgId } })`, return `apiSuccess(signer, 201)`.

Create src/app/api/signers/[id]/route.ts. PATCH handler: authenticate, load signer by id (404 if not found or deletedAt is not null), parse body with `UpdateSignerSchema`, update signer, call `writeAuditEvent({ action: 'SIGNER_UPDATED', ... })`, return updated signer. DELETE handler: authenticate, load signer (404 if not found or already soft-deleted), update `{ deletedAt: new Date(), isActive: false }`, call `writeAuditEvent({ action: 'SIGNER_DELETED', entityType: 'Signer', entityId: id, actorId: session.user.id, meta: { fullName: signer.fullName } })`, return `apiSuccess({ deleted: true })`.

Update src/app/api/organizations/[id]/signers/route.ts GET handler: add `deletedAt: null` to the where clause so the endpoint reads `where: { orgId: id, isActive: true, deletedAt: null }`. This ensures soft-deleted signers are excluded from the issuance form dropdown.

Create src/app/admin/signers/page.tsx as a server component. Use `export const instant = false`. Fetch the list of organizations from `db.organization.findMany({ orderBy: { name: 'asc' }, select: { id: true, name: true } })`. Render a `<PageHeader title='Signers' subtitle='Manage document signers for all organizations' />` and pass orgs to `<SignersClient orgs={orgs} />`. Add export `metadata = { title: 'Signers — WSS QR Signature' }`.

Create src/app/admin/signers/SignersClient.tsx as a 'use client' component. Props: `orgs: { id: string; name: string }[]`. State: selected `orgId` (defaults to orgs[0].id or empty), signer list, pagination, search string, loading, add-dialog open, edit-dialog open, delete-confirm open. On mount and when orgId/search/page changes, fetch `GET /api/signers?orgId=...&search=...&page=...&limit=20`. Render: (1) A top bar with a `<Select>` for organization (required) and a text search `<Input>`. (2) A `<DataTable>` with columns: Full Name (sortable), Title, Employee ID (shows '—' if null), Status (Active/Inactive badge using existing Badge or inline span), Actions (Edit button, Delete button). (3) An 'Add Signer' `<Button>` at top-right of PageHeader area. (4) Add/Edit `<Dialog>` with fields: Full Name (Input, required), Title (Input, required), Employee ID (Input, optional), Active (checkbox, label 'Active'). Submit calls POST or PATCH as appropriate. On success closes dialog, refreshes list, shows toast. (5) Delete confirm `<Dialog>`: 'This signer will be marked as inactive and hidden from new issuances. Existing records will be preserved.' Two buttons: Cancel, Confirm Delete (danger). On confirm calls DELETE /api/signers/[id]. (6) Note below the table in small gray text: 'Unit hierarchy (Division > Department > Sub-department) is planned for a future release.' Follow OrgUnitsManager.tsx patterns for inline state management. Use existing UI components only: Button, Input, Select, Dialog, DataTable, Toast, Badge. All inputs must have labels. Dialog must have aria-labelledby title.

Update src/components/layout/AdminLayout.tsx: import `Users` and `History` from 'lucide-react'. In NAV_ITEMS array, add `{ href: '/admin/signers', label: 'Signers', icon: Users, exact: false }` between the Issuances item and the Settings item. The New Issuance shortcut item can stay or be removed — keep it to match current nav. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx prisma generate` exits 0, src/generated/prisma types include Signer.deletedAt
GET /api/signers?orgId=X returns only signers where deletedAt IS NULL
DELETE /api/signers/[id] sets deletedAt and isActive=false, does not hard-delete
/admin/signers page renders organization selector and signer table
Add Signer dialog submits via POST /api/signers
Edit Signer dialog submits via PATCH /api/signers/[id]
Delete confirmation dialog calls DELETE /api/signers/[id] (soft delete)
Sidebar shows 'Signers' nav item between Issuances and Settings
findings: All 8 steps implemented. Migration added deletedAt DateTime? to Signer. Prisma client regenerated with new field. Signer schemas (Create/Update) created in src/lib/schemas/signer.ts. GET+POST /api/signers and PATCH+DELETE /api/signers/[id] routes created with requireAdmin, writeAuditEvent, and apiSuccess/apiError patterns. org signers endpoint updated with deletedAt:null filter. /admin/signers server page and SignersClient client component created following OrgUnitsManager pattern. AdminLayout updated with Users icon and Signers nav item between New Issuance and Settings. npx prisma migrate dev, npx prisma generate, npm run typecheck, and npm run build all exit 0.
